claim: InferencePool functions like a Service with a selector: it selects a group of Pods directly by label selector and target port, not by referencing a Service or EndpointSlice object.
scope_conditions: Gateway API Inference Extension v1.1.x, Alpha stage, as of Nov 2025
quoted_support: InferencePool is the core resource introduced by the Inference Extension, used to describe a group of inference Pods and routing plugin configurations. It is similar to a Service with a selector, responsible for selecting a group of model service Pods.

claim: InferencePoolImport is the API mechanism for importing InferencePools defined in remote clusters into a local cluster, intended for consistent governance of multi-cluster and multi-region inference services.
stance_target: multi-cluster InferencePool import as a way to reach backends in other clusters
scope_conditions: OSS Gateway API Inference Extension, Alpha, v1.1.x
quoted_support: InferencePoolImport supports importing InferencePools defined in remote clusters into the local cluster, facilitating consistent governance of multi-cluster, multi-region inference services.

claim: As of November 2025, Gateway API Inference Extension is at v1.1.x and officially in Alpha stage; official guidance is not to use it directly in production and to prefer managed implementations like GKE Inference Gateway or commercial gateway vendors instead.
stance_target: production-readiness of the OSS Gateway API Inference Extension stack this project would customize
quoted_support: The current project version is v1.1.x, overall in the Alpha stage. Official recommendation is not to use it directly in production yet; it's more suitable for platform teams to experiment with the technology stack.

claim: The Gateway API Inference Extension terminology has shifted from an earlier InferenceModel + InferencePool combination to the current InferenceObjective + InferencePool (with optional InferencePoolImport) naming.
quoted_support: Early documentation often mentioned the InferenceModel + InferencePool CRD combination; the latest specification has evolved to InferenceObjective + InferencePool (with optional InferencePoolImport).
